decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed extensions, if constructed together as secured by legal agreement, due to their position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 34 and 36 Rosemary Avenue. The development would be compatible with the visual amenity of the locality, would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties, and would not result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4, T.1.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002). It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the separate single-family dwellinghouses known as 34 and 36 Rosemary Avenue.

Condition : 7 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: ERECTION OF A TWO-STOREY REAR EXTENSION, SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION, AND REAR ROOF DORMER TO NUMBER 34, AND THE ERECTION OF A FIRST FLOOR REAR EXTENSION AND SIDE AND REAR ROOF DORMERS TO NUMBER 36
